subject: how to deal with a pending App

messages.author: 935477bf2c8a3736
messages.subject: how to deal with a pending App
parts:
I deployed an apps few days ago and I had as reply

##############################
##### End Log ###################################
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 2726367 failed: Error parsing manifest: Maximum supported R version is: 3.1.1


Now this apps is in the PENDING status.
What do I do?

I tried to terminate it but I didn't get it.

Many thanks

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] how to deal with a pending App
parts:
Nino,

Two things:

1) You should be able to terminate your app by doing:

terminateApp("your-app-name")

2) We actually added support for R 3.1.2 as of yesterday, so you should all set to re-deploy your app by running:

deployApp()

Hope that helps.

-Andy
